title: Vegetable and Paneer Korma with Cashew Cream and Toasted Almonds
summary: Paneer is fried golden, onions are softened slowly with whole and ground spices, yoghurt is cooked in stages until the fat separates, then cashew cream and vegetables are simmered until tender and finished with garam masala and toasted almonds.
equipment: large heavy pot or casserole with a lid

ingredients.item: floury potato, peeled and cut into 1.5 cm cubes
carrot, peeled and cut into 1.5 cm cubes
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make cashew cream
steps.text: Blend the cashews with boiling water until smooth.

steps.title: Fry the paneer
steps.text: Fry the paneer cubes in ghee until golden and set aside.

steps.title: Soften the onions
steps.text: Cook the onions covered until soft, then add the garlic, ginger and spices.

steps.title: Cook the yoghurt
steps.text: Add the yoghurt in stages until the fat separates, then stir in the tomato purée and cashew cream.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer the vegetables covered until tender, then add the paneer and peas.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with garam masala, toasted almonds and coriander and serve with rice or flatbread.

tips: Add the yoghurt slowly over high heat so it does not split.
Stir often once the cashew cream is in; nuts catch easily.
Cut the vegetables to an even size so they cook together.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days and reheat gently with a splash of water until piping hot. Freezing is not recommended because the paneer turns rubbery. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
